rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the winner of a game or contest.

example.english: They have been the champion for three years in a row.
example.jyutping: keoi5 lin4 zuk6 saam1 nin4 dou1 hai6 gun3 gwan1

rows.note: Use this for someone who actively fights for a cause or ideal rather than for a contest winner.

example.english: They are a champion of environmental protection.
example.traditional: 佢係為環保出力嘅鬥士。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 wai6 waan4 bou2 ceot1 lik6 ge3 dau3 si6

rows.note: Use this when the person or team is competing as the representative of a group or place.

example.english: Ming is the champion representing Hong Kong this time.
example.traditional: 阿明係今次代表香港出賽嘅代表。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 hai6 gam1 ci3 doi6 biu2 hoeng1 gong2 ceot1 coi3 ge3 doi6 biu2
